title: Testing, Debugging, and Documentation
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of testing, debugging, and documentation in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 15: Testing, Debugging, and Documentation. Lessons in order: Introduction to Software Testing in Swift; Swift Testing Fundamentals; Advanced Swift Testing; XCTest and Legacy Test Suites; Mocking, Fakes, and Test Dependencies; Debugging Swift Programs; Compiler Diagnostics and Runtime Failures; Performance and Memory Profiling Tools; Code Coverage and Regression Testing; Documentation with DocC; Logging and Diagnostics; Continuous Integration for Swift; Code Review and Quality Standards.
